text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Do your best~ Royce!! Moving up, moving 
up, moving up!! You can do it~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing! A new power clean record! Man~ 
you're so buff~.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This was supposed to be a challenge video 
to move fans to tears with 'working hard 
and finally setting a new personal 
best'...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Somehow... it's just effortlessly rising 
up!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. A while ago, it wrapped up quite 
dramatically, where with everyone's 
cheers, they finally succeeded on the 
third attempt, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but... in the end, isn't it just 
that? Royce just grew at an incredible 
speed."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—So this is the training video you took 
yesterday. I see... at the moment of the 
finish, maybe I'm putting a bit too much 
power into my forearms.
choice_data_list:
I put together a quick summary of the 
issues with your form, but...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! Thanks! All right, let's adjust it bit 
by bit based on that!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. So the results are exceeding 
expectations, then—”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... everyone. I'm sorry, 
but would you mind bearing with me a 
little longer while we change the video's 
concept?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Royce-chan, rapidly honing her skills 
with a future performance you just can't 
miss!" ...kinda like that!
